identity.name: EDR-Blinding Race — BYOVD Sensor-Tamper t0 Stitched to Cobalt Strike C2 and rclone SFTP Exfil, Time-to-Contain Measured
identity.summary: One host loads the wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys vulnerable driver and runs disabler.exe to strip EDR hooks (t0), then beacons to a Cobalt Strike C2 and exfiltrates over SFTP with a renamed rclone. An XSIAM correlation rule anchors t0 on the tamper, stitches the C2 beacon and bulk SFTP egress on the same host, and scores elapsed tamper-to-exfil time as the F6 MTTR / time-to-contain KPI.
identity.description: This is the corpus's first F6 (Response Timing) exemplar and models the extortion intrusion Unit 42 reported in 'EDR bypass extortion attempt thwarted', attributed to a KernelMode / Marti71 operator whose tradecraft overlaps the leaked Conti playbook (Unit 42 notes the overlap but makes no Conti attribution — an encrypted ContiTraining.rar archive was present with no evidence the attackers used it). The value of the incident is an elapsed-time metric, not a new signature: the correlation rule fixes a t0 on the moment EDR is blinded and measures how much attacker dwell elapses before bulk data leaves the host — the number a DC uses to prove Cortex's cross-plane timeline reconstruction and time-to-contain. The chain: (1) EDR plane — the host loads a legitimately-signed but vulnerable driver (wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys, SHA256 6106d1ce671b92d522144fcd3bc01276a975fe5d5b0fde09ca1cca16d09b7143) via Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver, and disabler.exe (an EDRSandBlast fork with the CLI stripped) uses that kernel primitive to remove user-mode hooks and kernel-mode callbacks — the sensor-tamper t0. (2) NDR plane — a Cobalt Strike beacon (watermark 1357776117) begins calling out to beamofthemoon.com / mail.beamofthemoon.com / store.beamofthemoon.com and 180.131.145.85. (3) NDR plane — rclone renamed vmware.exe opens a sustained SFTP session to 82.192.88.95 and exfiltrates. Because the driver is signed and the driver-load event on its own is low-severity, and because rclone-over-SSH looks like admin file transfer, no single plane's alert conveys the urgency; the differentiation is the stitch. The correlation rule joins on agent_hostname plus the causality actor, opens its window at the driver-load t0, requires the C2 beacon and the SFTP egress to bind to the same host within that window, and emits elapsed_seconds = t(first SFTP exfil) - t0(driver load) as the primary KPI. Two EDR BIOCs catch the BYOVD driver load and the disabler.exe hook-removal tool; two NDR hunt XQLs surface the Cobalt Strike beacon and the rclone SFTP egress; a metric XQL computes the tamper-to-exfil elapsed time; a validation XQL confirms t0 is observable; the correlation rule fuses them into one time-to-contain incident. The scenario is a NON-DESTRUCTIVE, SAFE-MODE emulation on Linux (marker files + loopback-only representative telemetry — it never contacts the real malicious C2 or SFTP infrastructure); the deployable detection bodies target the real Windows telemetry the technique produces.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses (T1562.001 — Disable or Modify Tools)

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-MP-012 — EDR-blinding race BYOVD sensor-tamper t0 stitched to Cobalt Strike C2 and rclone SFTP exfil; F6 tamper-to-exfil time-to-contain measurement.

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR / XSIAM agent installed on the target host so driver-load and per-process telemetry reaches xdr_data.
NGFW / Cortex NDR forwards session logs into the tenant so the C2 beacon and SFTP egress land in pan_ngfw_traffic on the same host key.

payload.code:
# NON-DESTRUCTIVE SAFE-MODE emulation of the EDR-blinding -> C2 -> SFTP-exfil
# chain. No real malicious infrastructure is contacted: the C2 and SFTP legs
# use loopback only and the BYOVD/tamper legs are represented by marker files.
# The deployable detections target the real Windows telemetry; this payload
# only produces the causality SHAPE (t0 -> beacon -> exfil) for the stitch.
set -euo pipefail
MARK=/tmp/cortexsim_mp012
# (1) EDR t0 — BYOVD sensor-tamper marker (represents wnbios.sys load + disabler.exe)
echo '[CortexSim][t0] BYOVD driver-load + EDR-hook-removal marker' > "${MARK}_wnbios.sys.marker"
echo '[CortexSim] disabler.exe (EDRSandBlast fork) sensor-tamper marker' > "${MARK}_disabler.marker"
# (2) NDR — Cobalt Strike beacon SHAPE (loopback, 5 short callbacks)
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s --max-time 3 "http://${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}/mp012/beacon?wm=1357776117&iter=${i}" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; done
# (3) NDR — rclone(vmware.exe) SFTP exfil SHAPE (marker + loopback session)
echo '[CortexSim] rclone renamed vmware.exe SFTP exfil marker' > "${MARK}_exfil.marker"
curl -s --max-time 3 "http://${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}/mp012/sftp-egress" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-MP-012 chain shape emitted (t0 -> beacon -> exfil)'

input_variables.name: STAGE_HOST
input_variables.description: Authorised loopback/collector the representative beacon and SFTP-egress shapes reach. Never the real C2 or SFTP endpoint.

expected_artifacts.description: The BYOVD sensor-tamper t0 marker representing the wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys driver load and disabler.exe hook removal.
Representative Cobalt Strike beacon callbacks (loopback) standing in for the beamofthemoon.com C2 traffic.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: 5 short outbound sessions from the same host after t0

expected_artifacts.description: Representative sustained SFTP egress session (loopback) standing in for the rclone(vmware.exe) exfil to 82.192.88.95.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: one egress session from the same host, after the beacon

iocs.context: wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys vulnerable driver loaded via BYOVD to blind EDR.
disabler.exe — EDRSandBlast fork that removes EDR user-mode hooks and kernel callbacks.
rclone renamed vmware.exe used for SFTP exfiltration.
Cobalt Strike C2 domain (also mail. and store. subdomains).
SFTP exfiltration endpoint (OpenSSH 8.4p1 Debian) reached by renamed rclone.

biocs.name: MP-012 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Load — wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys
biocs.description: The sensor-tamper t0. A signed-but-vulnerable driver (wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys) is loaded, giving a kernel read/write primitive used to blind EDR (Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver). The BIOC anchors on the module path or the known driver SHA256 rather than on a signature-status alone, because the driver is legitimately signed. This driver-load timestamp is the t0 the F6 correlation opens its window on.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.LOAD_IMAGE and event_sub_type = ENUM.DRIVER_LOAD
| filter action_module_path contains "wnbios" or action_module_path contains "wn_64" or action_module_sha256 = "6106d1ce671b92d522144fcd3bc01276a975fe5d5b0fde09ca1cca16d09b7143"
| comp min(_time) as tamper_t0, count() as driver_loads by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_instance_id, causality_id, action_module_sha256
| filter driver_loads >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_instance_id, causality_id, action_module_sha256, tamper_t0, driver_loads

biocs.name: MP-012 EDR Hook Removal via disabler.exe (EDRSandBlast Fork)
biocs.description: disabler.exe — a public EDRSandBlast fork with the CLI stripped — uses the BYOVD kernel primitive to remove EDR user-mode hooks and kernel-mode callbacks. The BIOC keys on the tool image/SHA256 AND on the causality_actor_process_image_name + causality_id that owns it, so the hook-removal binds to the SAME foothold (CGO) that just loaded the vulnerable driver — confirming the tamper is a deliberate step in one chain, not an incidental signed-driver load.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = "disabler.exe" or action_process_image_sha256 = "3758c5eb1fbab2362ef23091f082710606c1b4ebaeaff9b514896dc2a1e2ab17"
| comp min(_time) as tamper_tool_time, count() as tamper_events by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, causality_id, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_sha256
| filter tamper_events >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, causality_id, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_sha256, tamper_tool_time, tamper_events

xql_queries.name: MP-012 Cobalt Strike Beacon to beamofthemoon.com C2 Infrastructure
xql_queries.query:
dataset = pan_ngfw_traffic
| filter dst_host in ("beamofthemoon.com", "mail.beamofthemoon.com", "store.beamofthemoon.com") or dst_ip = "180.131.145.85"
| comp min(_time) as first_beacon, count() as beacon_sessions, sum(bytes_sent) as bytes_out by source_ip, dst_host
| filter beacon_sessions >= 3
| sort desc beacon_sessions
| fields source_ip, dst_host, first_beacon, beacon_sessions, bytes_out

xql_queries.name: MP-012 rclone SFTP Bulk Exfil to 82.192.88.95
xql_queries.query:
dataset = pan_ngfw_traffic
| filter dst_ip = "82.192.88.95" and (dst_port = 22 or app = "ssh" or app = "sftp")
| comp min(_time) as first_exfil, count() as sftp_sessions, sum(bytes_sent) as bytes_exfiltrated by source_ip, dst_ip
| filter bytes_exfiltrated >= 1000000
| sort desc bytes_exfiltrated
| fields source_ip, dst_ip, first_exfil, sftp_sessions, bytes_exfiltrated

xql_queries.name: MP-012 Tamper-to-Exfil Elapsed Time (F6 MTTR KPI)
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.LOAD_IMAGE and event_sub_type = ENUM.DRIVER_LOAD and (action_module_path contains "wnbios" or action_module_path contains "wn_64" or action_module_sha256 = "6106d1ce671b92d522144fcd3bc01276a975fe5d5b0fde09ca1cca16d09b7143")
| comp min(_time) as tamper_t0 by agent_hostname, action_local_ip
| join type = inner (
    dataset = pan_ngfw_traffic
    | filter dst_ip = "82.192.88.95"
    | comp min(_time) as first_exfil by source_ip ) as exfil exfil.source_ip = action_local_ip
| alter time_to_exfil_seconds = timestamp_diff(first_exfil, tamper_t0, "SECOND")
| fields agent_hostname, action_local_ip, tamper_t0, first_exfil, time_to_exfil_seconds

xql_queries.name: MP-012 BYOVD Driver-Load t0 Observed
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter event_type = ENUM.LOAD_IMAGE and event_sub_type = ENUM.DRIVER_LOAD
| filter action_module_path contains "wnbios" or action_module_path contains "wn_64"
| comp count() as tamper_events by agent_hostname
| filter tamper_events >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, tamper_events

correlation_rules.name: MP-012 EDR-Blinding Race — Tamper-to-Exfil Time-to-Contain Stitch
correlation_rules.logic: Anchors t0 on BIOC(MP-012 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Load — wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys) and BIOC(MP-012 EDR Hook Removal via disabler.exe (EDRSandBlast Fork)) for one agent_hostname, then requires XQL(MP-012 Cobalt Strike Beacon to beamofthemoon.com C2 Infrastructure) and XQL(MP-012 rclone SFTP Bulk Exfil to 82.192.88.95) to bind to the same agent_hostname and causality actor within a 3600s window opened at t0. Fires ONE incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes and carries elapsed_seconds = first_exfil - tamper_t0 (from XQL(MP-012 Tamper-to-Exfil Elapsed Time (F6 MTTR KPI))) as the F6 time-to-contain KPI: the dwell an operator got between blinding the sensor and moving data. Time-to-contain passes when the stitched incident is raised before that exfil window closes.

dataset = xdr_data | filter event_type = ENUM.LOAD_IMAGE and event_sub_type = ENUM.DRIVER_LOAD | filter action_module_path contains "wnbios" or action_module_path contains "wn_64"

use_cases.name: Tamper-to-Exfil Time-to-Contain via Cortex Cross-Plane Correlation (F6)
use_cases.description: When an operator blinds EDR with a signed vulnerable driver and moves fast to beacon and exfiltrate, no single plane's alert conveys the urgency. Cortex fixes a t0 on the sensor-tamper, stitches the C2 beacon and bulk SFTP egress from the same host into one incident, and reports the elapsed tamper-to-exfil time — the number that proves whether the SOC would have contained the host before data left it.

test_cases.objective: The BYOVD sensor-tamper t0, the Cobalt Strike beacon, and the rclone SFTP egress on one host stitch into a single time-to-contain incident.
preconditions: Target with the Cortex XDR agent installed.
NGFW / NDR session logs forwarded into the tenant.
steps: Emulate the BYOVD driver load + disabler.exe hook removal (t0).
Emit the representative Cobalt Strike beacon shape from the same host.
Emit the representative rclone SFTP egress shape from the same host.
Observe the two EDR BIOCs and two NDR XQLs fire and CR-MP-0017 raise one incident.
success_criteria: BIOC `MP-012 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Load — wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys` fires and sets tamper_t0.
XQL `MP-012 Cobalt Strike Beacon to beamofthemoon.com C2 Infrastructure` and XQL `MP-012 rclone SFTP Bulk Exfil to 82.192.88.95` bind to the same agent_hostname.
Correlation `CR-MP-0017` raises exactly one stitched incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes.

test_cases.objective: The stitched incident reports a non-zero elapsed tamper-to-exfil time (the F6 MTTR / time-to-contain KPI).
preconditions: TC-MP-012A produced a single stitched incident.
steps: Run the metric XQL against the incident's host.
success_criteria: XQL `MP-012 Tamper-to-Exfil Elapsed Time (F6 MTTR KPI)` returns a positive time_to_exfil_seconds.
The incident surfaces the elapsed tamper-to-exfil time as the primary KPI.

test_cases.objective: The BYOVD driver load is detected on its own signed-driver merit (t0 observability).
preconditions: Target with the Cortex XDR agent installed.
steps: Emulate only the BYOVD driver load.
success_criteria: XQL `MP-012 BYOVD Driver-Load t0 Observed` returns at least one row for the host.
BIOC `MP-012 EDR Hook Removal via disabler.exe (EDRSandBlast Fork)` fires when disabler.exe runs on the same host.

preventive_controls: Enable the Microsoft vulnerable-driver blocklist / HVCI and Cortex XDR's blocklist so wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys and other known BYOVD drivers cannot load, converting the tamper t0 from detected to blocked.
Enforce EDR tamper protection and anti-tampering so removal of user-mode hooks / kernel callbacks requires a protected action.
Egress-filter and inspect outbound SSH/SFTP from workstations at the NGFW so rclone-over-SSH exfil to unknown endpoints is blocked, not just logged.
Restrict RMM (Atera) install/execution to an allowlist to close the initial-access path.
detection_engineering: Author the F6 correlation to open its window on the driver-load / EDR-tamper t0, not on the exfil, so the elapsed tamper-to-exfil time is measurable as a response-timing KPI.
Alert on any signed-but-vulnerable driver load correlated with an EDR-hook-removal tool on the same host and causality actor.
Treat a Cobalt Strike beacon and a bulk SFTP egress from a host whose EDR was just tampered as one incident, joined on agent_hostname, rather than three independent low-severity events.
Feed the elapsed tamper-to-exfil time into the measurement loop as the time-to-contain metric the DC reports.
